about_the_game:
When you wake up, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious room. It appears that to escape, you must answer a series of True/False questions correctly.

Before you stand two walls—one marked with “T” and the other with “F.” Choose the wall you believe is correct, and with both caution and courage, make your leap.

This is a True/False question that puts your knowledge and judgment to the test. Can you answer correctly and escape from this peculiar room?

Play Time

Approximately 10 minutes to 1 hour

Options

By turning on “Cheat Mode,” the game will pause even after a question is presented. This allows you the freedom to look things up, so if you find yourself stuck, feel free to try it out.

About the True/False questions

Not all of the questions are generated solely by AI; some have been personally crafted and adjusted by the creator.

Video Streaming and Posting Guidelines

This game is available for video streaming or uploading by anyone, whether individual or corporate, without prior permission. Please adhere to the following guidelines when doing so:

• Include the URL of the Steam store page in the video description or similar sections.
• Monetization is permitted only if you use the features provided by video platforms, such as YouTube’s "YouTube Partner Program."
• Refrain from streaming or posting content that violates local laws or public decency.

Please note that these guidelines may be updated without notice.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violence (no blood) that is not suitable for all ages.
